overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Council met in person but provided adequate alternative public access via live TV and web broadcast under Section (1) of the COVID-19 Executive Order.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Council violated the OML by meeting in person June 23 but barring public attendance, offering only live broadcast viewing.
allegations.key_passage: The Council was permitted to avail itself of the relief provided in Section (1) of the Executive Order, even though the Council members opted to meet in person.
